title: Lovely sailing experience!
text: We enjoyed the sailing trip! What a great way to see the coast of Barcelona and relax for a few hours.
author: Sudie_B

title: Our guide was so gracious...
text: Our guide was so gracious moving our event from a rainy to a non rainy day. Tour of the water was incredible. Guide was very personable. So worth it.
author: Harjinder_S

title: Just the two of us and Jorge (the captain) on a beautiful sailing trip
text: This was the first sailing experience for me and boy was it a treat! The views of the beaches on the coast, the silent running with just the wind (a huge change from all of the motorboats in my past) and a great captain, Jorge, who added some Spanish charm to the trip made for a wonderful day.  The boat was well-maintained and clean and the snacks were a nice touch.  Would do it again in a heartbeat!
author: darrenlinscott

title: The best experience!
text: The private yacht was amazing and Jorge was the best skipper. We were able to play music and go on the front of the boat, which was so fun! Jorge also provided snacks and drinks for us. Highly recommend and if I go back I’ll definitely be booking up again!
author: W5878MIrobynl

title: Totally recommend
text: Very pleasant and fun. Cheap and worth it. If you are visiting Barcelona this is a must. Our captain was also very friendly.
author: mohamednourb278

title: Unforgettable Experience – A Must-Do in Barcelona!
text:
Our Barcelona Unforgettable Sailing Cruise was truly one of the highlights of our trip! From the moment we stepped on board, the crew was incredibly attentive and welcoming. They went above and beyond to make sure my entire family felt comfortable and cared for throughout the cruise.

The open bar and snacks were a great touch—everything was fresh, and the drinks kept flowing! The views of the Barcelona coastline were absolutely stunning, and the atmosphere on the boat was both relaxing and fun. title: Highlight of our trip to Barcelona!!!
text:
My wife and I had a top tier experience with Jorge. His boat is beautiful and clean and Jorge took wonderful care of us. We had snacks and drinks and took in all the beautiful sights. 

It was hands down the most amazing part of our trip to Spain.  I highly encourage you to book this trip immediately.  

Andrew 
(USA - Louisiana)
author: Andrew Z

title: Beautiful evening on the sailboat
text:
We had a fantastic sundowner tour with our group of 10 people – just perfect from start to finish! The skipper was incredibly attentive and personable, explained a lot to us and really cared about making everyone feel comfortable. There were plenty of drinks – cava, beer, sangria – and always supplies if you wanted.

A real highlight of our stay – highly recommended! 🌞⛵️🥂
author: Gitta R

title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An unforgettable sundowner on the sea!
text:
We were with a group of 10 people on a sundowner sailing tour and had a fantastic time! Everything was perfectly organized from the beginning. Our skipper was super friendly, explained a lot about the surroundings and sailing and always made sure we didn’t miss anything – whether drinks, seats at the front of the boat or even blankets when it got a little cooler later.
